finalText:
Redis died first. At 02:15:10 the app started timing out talking to the store, and by 02:15:26 it logged its first failed redis reconnect at `10.0.0.12:6379`, connection refused.

From there it never recovered. It kept retrying every ~80 seconds, 13 tries in all, and every try failed the same way. With no cache, every request became a slow store lookup, so the request queue climbed steadily, crossing its limit of 500 at 02:29:12.

That backlog piled up in memory until worker-2 ran out of it at 02:31:44 and crashed. The supervisor restarted it a second later, but the api process was already stuck and unresponsive, so at 02:31:52 the supervisor killed the whole process group. That's the outage.

Root cause: Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` went unreachable around 02:15 and stayed down, and nothing shed load while the app kept retrying and queuing. Getting Redis back up and adding a queue cutoff would prevent a repeat.
